FEAT-4-STORY-59.title: Implement Pydantic Validation for Provider Detail Response
FEAT-4-STORY-59.description: Define and enforce a Pydantic model for provider detail responses to validate structure, required fields, and data types before returning results to the facade.

FEAT-4-STORY-60.title: Validate External Provider Links via URL Guardian
FEAT-4-STORY-60.description: Integrate url_guardian to validate and sanitize all generated external links (state boards, research sites) before returning them in provider detail responses.

FEAT-4-STORY-61.title: Add Robust Error Handling for NPI Registry Failures
FEAT-4-STORY-61.description: Implement retry logic, timeout handling, and graceful fallback responses when the NPI Registry API is unavailable or returns incomplete data.

FEAT-4-STORY-62.title: Implement Caching Layer for Provider Detail Lookups
FEAT-4-STORY-62.description: Add a short-lived caching mechanism for NPI lookup results to reduce repeated external API calls and improve response latency.
